channel.description: Recent content in crossfire-pro on CrossFire PRO Procedures & Reference
channel.copyright: © 2026 Bernie Lindsey. Personal notes, unlisted. Not affiliated with Langmuir Systems, Razorweld, or Jasic. Settings are starting points, not proven; follow the manufacturers' manuals and safety instructions first. [About this site](/about/)

item.title: FireControl Straight Cut: Starting a Cut at the Plate Edge
item.description: Three ways to start a FireControl Straight Cut right at the plate edge with IHS on a CrossFire PRO. Method 1, a scrap lead-in piece, is the one I’ve used.

item.title: THC Setup, Tuning, and Stopping Torch Dives
item.description: Wiring check, Langmuir default settings, and fixes for torch dives with the Langmuir THC on a CrossFire PRO and a CUT45 using the 50:1 divider port.

item.title: Scenario: FireControl Won't Open ("Child process exited with code 1")
item.description: FireControl crashes on startup, or Windows shows “Child process exited with code 1”. The most-viewed FireControl problem on the forum. Langmuir staff tie it to power-efficient AMD “U” CPUs and a Windows update; FireControl 24.1.6 is the staff fix.

item.title: Work Clamp, Grounding, and Electrical Noise (EMI)
item.description: Where to put the work clamp, how to run Langmuir’s electronics isolation test, and how to break ground loops safely, without ever defeating a safety ground.

item.title: Scenario: FireControl Won't Connect (CrossFire Greyed Out, COM Port Instead of Firmware)
item.description: FireControl opens, but the CrossFire indicator stays grey, shows a COM port number instead of a firmware version, or comes and goes. Causes and fixes from the computer to the drivers to the motion control board, from Langmuir’s troubleshooting page and the forum.

item.title: Scenario: FireControl Drops the Connection or Freezes Mid-Cut (the Computer Side)
item.description: A cut stops part-way: FireControl freezes, goes blank, says “Machine disconnected” or “Program cancelled”, or throws a Java error. Electrical noise is the usual suspect and has its own page. This page covers the computer, USB, power-saving, and FireControl-install causes, plus a test to tell them apart.

item.title: Scenario: Resuming a Cut After a Stop (Resume, Run From Loop, Run From Line)
item.description: The torch went out, a consumable failed, or you had to stop part-way through a sheet. When Resume works, when you need Run From Here (loop or line), how to keep the work zero, and why the orange button sometimes does nothing.

item.title: Scenario: The Part Cuts in the Wrong Place (Work Zero, Set Program Origin, and the SheetCAM Origin)
item.description: The part cuts in the middle of the sheet, off the edge, or FireControl says it’s out of bounds. On a PRO without limit switches there are three things to line up: where the torch is when you press Zero All Axes, which corner Set Program Origin points at, and where SheetCAM put the part relative to its origin.

item.title: Pierce Height, Pierce Delay, and Cut Height
item.description: Pierce height, pierce delay, and cut height for a CrossFire PRO with IHS, THC, the SheetCAM FireControl post v1.6, and the CUT45 with the X45 torch: how IHS works, starting values, and a ten-pierce test.

item.title: Scenario: FireControl Won't Load the Program ("No Program Speed Found", "Program Check Encountered an Error", "Unsupported GCode")
item.description: FireControl rejects a file while it’s validating it. On the forum the cause is nearly always the post processor, a CAM rule that writes a code FireControl doesn’t know, or loading with the table disconnected. How to read the file’s first and last lines to tell which.

item.title: Squaring the Gantry and Fixing Lost Steps
item.description: Checking and squaring the CrossFire PRO gantry, tightening couplers, and working through Langmuir’s lost-steps and stalling checks, from coupler slip to damaged motor plugs.

item.title: Test-Cut Program: Checking the Starting Settings, Coupon by Coupon
item.description: A planned, coupon-by-coupon test program for checking the Razorweld-supplied chart (and the T45m-format chart’s voltages) on a CrossFire PRO with the CUT45 and X45 torch, with every cut logged.

item.title: Indexing Parts Longer Than the Table
item.description: How to cut a part longer than the CrossFire PRO’s 33 in of Y travel by splitting it into two programs and sliding the sheet. Compiled from Langmuir features and forum methods.

item.title: CrossFire PRO Plasma Procedures
item.description:
Last updated: 30 October 2026

Personal notes, unlisted. I’m Bernie Lindsey, and I’ve run my CrossFire PRO since August 2024. These are my notes, put together with help from an AI research assistant that read Langmuir and Razorweld documents and Langmuir forum posts. Where a page says “I” or “my”, it means me and my machine. Most of this is compiled research I haven’t tried yet; each page has a status line saying which. Not affiliated with Langmuir Systems, Razorweld, or Jasic. Follow the manufacturers’ manuals, safety instructions, and support advice over anything here. More in About this site, including a glossary.
